features.name: Table Data Information Management Page with Index Drilldown
features.description: A new page feature that allows users to drill down from the table information page to see per-index information on a per-table, per-company basis. Users can now view index size and advanced index usage information previously only available at the aggregated table level.

features.name: Index Field and Coverage Information Display
features.description: A detailed view showing which fields are in an index and which fields are included in the index, allowing administrators and developers to determine whether an index is covering based on query types without viewing source code.

features.name: Runtime Index Toggle Capability in Client
features.description: The ability to turn indexes on and off directly in the Business Central client at runtime. Some indexes defined as unique cannot be disabled, but most indexes can be toggled. Disabled indexes are queued for activation in the next maintenance window in SaaS or immediately in on-premises installations.
caveats: Disabled indexes are queued for subsequent maintenance window in SaaS
Immediate in local or on-premises deployments

features.name: Per-Company Selective Index Activation
features.description: The capability to ship indexes that are disabled by default and selectively enable them per company based on functionality usage and data characteristics. This allows companies to avoid storage and update costs for indexes not needed for their use cases.

features.name: Index Lifecycle Telemetry Events
features.description: New telemetry events LC 63 and 64 track index enable and disable operations at runtime through the client. These complement existing lifecycle events for AL-based index operations and are documented on ak.ms/bctelemetry.
